game_title: Call Stack Tower – Blizzard Bridge Streak
game_concept: A rhythm puzzle set in Snowy Hold – Blizzard Bridge, a bridge in a blizzard: the innkeeper must handle snow wraiths while practicing functions. Core idea – Call Stack Tower: Trace nested function calls as stacked blocks and unwind them in order.
theme: Snowy Hold – Blizzard Bridge: a bridge in a blizzard
core_gameplay_loop: In Blizzard Bridge, repeat each round: Trace nested function calls as stacked blocks and unwind them in order. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the stack_height value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 6 consecutive correct decisions about stack_height to power up the innkeeper and open the hold gate.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 2 (intro tier): Call Stack Tower
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
